Description: Schottky 40 V 1 A SOD-323: USB into the system rail
USB-C receptacle, USB 2.0, 16 pin, top mount: power, charging and flashing (ESP32-C6 native USB)
LED green 0603: status under the front light pipe
P-MOSFET -30 V -4 A SOT-23: battery into the system rail when USB is absent
Tact switch 6 x 6 x 5 mm SMD under the top cap: tap = I'm awake, hold = test / pair
Slide switch SPDT right-angle SMD (C&K PCM12): on = LDO enabled, off = EN to GND
LDO 3.3 V 600 mA, SOT-23-5, enabled by the power switch
ESP32-C6 Wi-Fi 6 / BLE 5 / 802.15.4 module (ESP-NOW), 4 MB flash, PCB antenna, 13.2 x 16.6 x 2.4 mm
I2S MEMS microphone, bottom port over a 1 mm hole through the board, L/R low = left slot
LiPo 3.7 V ~2000 mAh with protection PCB, 103450 (10 x 34 x 50 mm), leads soldered to J2
